sections.heading: Right to Information (RTI) Compliance
paragraphs: In accordance with the provisions of the **Right to Information Act, 2005**, The New Horizons Institute of Technology maintains proactive disclosure of its academic regulations, approvals, fee structures, and administrative framework to ensure accountability and public transparency.
Any citizen of India seeking specific institutional information may file a written application addressed to the Public Information Officer (PIO) accompanied by the prescribed statutory fee.

sections.heading: Procedure for Submitting an RTI Application
items: **Application Format:** Draft an application in English or Bengali stating clearly the specific information sought, along with the applicant's full name, contact address, and phone number.

**Application Fee:** Enclose a non-refundable application fee of ₹10/- (Rupees Ten only) via Demand Draft, Indian Postal Order (IPO), or cash receipt from the institute accounts counter, payable to "The New Horizons Institute of Technology".
**Postal Delivery:** Send via Registered/Speed Post or deliver in person to the Public Information Officer, NHIT Campus, Phase-II, City Center, Durgapur — 713208.
**Time Limit for Response:** The PIO will furnish information or reply within **30 days** from the date of receipt, as mandated under Section 7(1) of the RTI Act 2005.

sections.heading: Zero-Tolerance Anti-Ragging Policy

sections.heading: Engineering Futures in Eastern India
paragraphs: **The New Horizons Institute of Technology (NHIT)** opened its first academic session on **16 August 2007** at Durgapur. Established under the aegis of **Durgapur Ispat People's Society** (registered under the West Bengal Societies Registration Act XXVI of 1961), NHIT was founded with a singular conviction: to create an institution where technical education is rigorous, hands-on, and accessible to students across West Bengal and neighboring states.

Today, NHIT is one of eastern India's largest diploma engineering institutes by student intake, running six diploma branches and an NCVT-approved Private ITI. The institute's foundational pass-out batch set the standard: **85% moved directly into industry employment or B.Tech lateral entry**.

sections.heading: Genesis of Durgapur Ispat People's Society
paragraphs: **Durgapur Ispat People's Society** is a non-profit registered educational society registered with the Registrar of Societies, Government of West Bengal under the West Bengal Societies Registration Act XXVI of 1961 (Registration No. **S/1L/18925 of 2003–2004**).

The idea germinated in **2004–2005**, when a distinguished collective of educators, industrial engineers, and philanthropic visionaries came together to realize their dream of spreading affordable, high-quality technical education throughout Eastern India.

On **16 August 2007**, the Society founded its flagship institution, **The New Horizons Institute of Technology (NHIT)**, offering AICTE-approved diploma programs in Mechanical, Electrical, and Civil Engineering. Over subsequent years, the Society expanded into Computer Science, Automobile Engineering, Electronics, and NCVT ITI trades.
sections.callout: “Durgapur had transformed into the primary industrial and educational hub of Eastern India, housing premier universities, engineering colleges, and secondary schools. However, a high-caliber polytechnic institution offering specialized 3-year diploma engineering tailored directly to core industries was conspicuously absent. The Society was formed to bridge this critical deficit.”

sections.sub: A transparent, hassle-free 5-stage admission procedure designed for aspiring polytechnic and ITI candidates.

items.title: Check Eligibility
items.desc: Class 10 (Madhyamik or equivalent) with Science, Mathematics & English. Minimum qualifying aggregate per Council norms. Relaxations apply for reserved/sports categories.

items.title: Apply & Counsel
items.desc: Collect and submit application form at the NHIT Admission Desk (Phase-II, City Centre, Durgapur) or register online. Connect with departmental academic counsellors.

items.title: Merit & Branch Selection
items.desc: Selection on Class 10 merit or state JEXPO rank following WBSCT&VE&SD norms. Branch preference is locked in directly with the admissions officer.

items.title: Verify & Enroll
items.desc: Marksheets, admit card, Aadhaar ID proof, and passport photos are verified on the spot. Initial semester fee payment completes institutional enrolment.

items.title: Begin Semester 1
items.desc: Campus induction, workshop floor allotment, and identity card issuance. Classes begin per State Council academic calendar with early workshop practice.

items.title: 1st Year Diploma Entry (After 10th / Madhyamik)
items.desc: Direct entry for school pass-outs into foundational and applied technical sciences. Replaces general high school theory with hands-on workshop craft and state-certified diploma curriculum.
bullets: Passed Class 10 / Madhyamik from any recognized Board with min. 35% aggregate marks.
Compulsory subjects: Mathematics, Physical Science, and English.
Valid rank in JEXPO counseling OR Direct Institutional Quota seat allotment.
No upper age limit as per AICTE and State Council directives.

items.title: 2nd Year Lateral Entry (VOCLET / ITI Pass-Outs)
items.desc: Fast-track 2-year diploma pathway directly into 3rd Semester with full credit recognition for 10+2 Science / Vocational or 2-Year ITI certificate holders. Saves an entire academic year.
bullets: Passed 10+2 with Physics/Chemistry/Math/Vocational OR 10th + 2-Year ITI trade.
Valid rank in VOCLET entrance examination conducted by WBSCTVESD.
Directly admitted to 3rd Semester across Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, CST, Automobile, ETCE.
Subsequent eligibility for B.Tech lateral entry through JELET.

sections.heading: 5. Statutory Grievance & Welfare Committees
paragraphs: To preserve student equity, mental wellbeing, academic fairness, and complete campus security, the following statutory bodies are instituted and functional:

items.title: Anti-Ragging Committee & Squad
items.desc: Operates 24x7 with faculty patrolling, student counsellors, local police liaison, and mandatory online undertaking via anti-ragging portal. Zero tolerance enforcement.

items.title: Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)
items.desc: Constituted under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, ensuring safe learning environment for female students and staff.

items.title: Student Grievance Redressal Cell (SGRC)
items.desc: Headed by Senior Faculty for examination, hostel, transport, or administrative appeals with statutory resolution timeframes.

items.title: SC / ST / OBC & Minority Cell
items.desc: Dedicated cell supervising state scholarships (SVMCM, OASIS, Aikyashree, National Scholarship Portal) and ensuring affirmative counseling without bias.
